title: Primärer Logoeinsatz
slide_intent: Choose logo contrast deliberately so the sender remains identifiable on every background.
strategic_value: Controlled red and white variants can preserve DB recognition across light, dark and photographic fields.
demonstration: Text limits the logo to DB Red or Clear White and four examples show appropriate background relationships.
practical_value: Select the permitted variant that supplies the strongest contrast for the actual background.

content_islands.name: Rule and rationale
content_islands.spec: Place color and contrast guidance above the examples.

content_islands.name: Variant matrix
content_islands.spec: Compare red on light grounds, red or white on dark ground and white over a dark photograph.

reference_purposes.Intent: The prose connects sufficient contrast to logo legibility and presence.
reference_purposes.Application: Four specimens demonstrate background-dependent variant selection.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The source limits logo colors to DB Red or Clear White and cites its own 4.5:1 / 3:1 contrast requirements.

ingredient.name: Logo color variant
ingredient.role: Keep the sender identifiable against its background.
ingredient.application: Use DB Red or Clear White and select by contrast; follow the source’s stated contrast requirements.
ingredient.scope: New-design logo guidance captured 2026-11-05; the ratios are recorded as source requirements, not independently certified accessibility results.
